The petitioner is before this Court calling in question proceedings in Crime No.4/2023 registered by the Mangaluru South Police Station pending on the file of the Additional Senior Civil Judge & CJM,
Mangaluru City for offences punishable under Section-420, 465, 467, 468 and 471 of IPC.

1.
